===Agility pet===
Upon returning to the Hallowed Sepulchre lobby via a magical obelisk, the player has a chance to receive the Agility [[pet]], the [[giant squirrel]]. The chance of obtaining the pet depends on the difficulty of the floor completed and is as follows:{{CiteVideo|url=https://youtu.be/DCC-PKa0eCo?t=1497|title=OSRS Modcast (Q&A) - Darkmeyer and Hallowed Sepulchre, Player Survey, and more!|timestamp=00:24:57|date=2020-05-27|author=Jagex|site=youtube.com}}
